summary: Implemented Ledger.total: sums approved entries of the tenant (refunds included), rounded to 2dp away from zero per DF-FXL-0007 (banker's rounding RQ-FXL-0103 is superseded).

criteria.criterion: Unapproved and other tenants' entries do not count; refunds included
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved and other tenants and includes refunds

summary: Implemented Ledger.approve using FxIdentity.isActive and hasRole, with check order session, Approver, NotFound (tenant-scoped), amendment RQ-FXL-0104 (amount > 10000 needs Approver and Admin, before self-approval), SelfApproval, AlreadyApproved. Sets Approved and ApprovedBy only.

criteria.criterion: Session idle exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: approve succeeds at exactly 15 minutes idle
approve admin without approver not authorized
approve other tenant is not found
approve self approval and already approved

criteria.criterion: Amount > 10,000 needs Approver and Admin; exactly 10,000 needs only Approver
criteria.test: approve high value needs admin too

summary: Implemented Ledger.view: SessionExpired if inactive (via isActive), else entries of the session's tenant in original order; no role widens it (DF-FXL-0005).

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view admin sees only own tenant in order

summary: Not implemented. RQ-FXL-0008 is only proposed with no acceptance criteria, and its dependency DF-FXL-0009 (exchange-rate source) is a draft with no decision and no rates available. Rounding and rate date are unspecified. convertCurrency left as is pending an accepted decision.

criteria.criterion: Convert amounts between ISO 4217 currencies using the chosen rates source
